_doc: PR tests-policy enforces unit diff and unit overall ratchet/dated module floors. Release candidates enforce real unit+emulator diff and combined ratchet/dated floors. No thresholds or dates are reduced. Release diff uses the nearest real combined ancestor excluding the candidate; the overall combined lookup includes the candidate. Both skip unit-only records. Unit-only main history omits combined. Scope: main.lua, weread/**/*.lua, integrations/**/*.lua; unexecuted files count as 0. Roadmap: docs/coverage-plan.md.
